rubrics.justification: Core grading is consistent with the provided 3AA and general blastocyst features, but the response adds image-specific findings like TE vacuolization, hemispheric asymmetry, and perivitelline debris that may be over-interpreted or not clearly verifiable.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, male factor, BMI, endometrial thickness, first-cycle status, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.
Overall logic is structured and internally consistent, with a plausible prognosis framework, though some numerical adjustments and emphasis on stress/endometrium are somewhat speculative.

Much of the discussion is broadly IVF-consistent, but several recommendations are not strongly guideline-based or are overreaching for this case, including strong PGT-A recommendation at age 28, ERA, immune workup, aspirin, sildenafil, and acupuncture.
Provides clear next-step options for transfer versus freeze-all and future workup, but some suggestions are more speculative than standard and may reduce clinical precision.
